$comment: Copy to workshop.config.json and fill in. Never commit the real file - it is gitignored.

licenses.$comment: Run ./src/Test-WorkshopSetup.ps1 to print the SKU part numbers this tenant actually owns, with free seats. Paid tenants have DYN365_BUSCENTRAL_ESSENTIAL or _PREMIUM; a trial tenant's Business Central licence is PROJECT_MADEIRA_PREVIEW_IW_SKU. The Power Apps Developer Plan is free and self-service, so POWERAPPS_DEV only appears once someone has signed up for it.

powerPlatform.$comment_placement: A tenant places environments either by location OR by macroRegion, never both. Test-WorkshopSetup.ps1 reports which mode this tenant uses and the valid values; set macroRegion and leave location alone if it says macro region.

businessCentral.$comment_permissions: D365 FULL ACCESS = full access to all data within the licence, WITHOUT Business Central administration. SUPER would add system admin and is blocked unless allowAdminPermissionSets is true.

mcp.$comment: clientId is the Entra app registered for MCP hosts: delegated permission Dynamics 365 Business Central > Financials.ReadWrite.All, public client, redirect URI http://localhost:33418/callback.
